profile_text.body:
Adobe is a publicly traded software company founded in 1982 and headquartered in San Jose, California, trading on public markets under the ticker ADBE. The company reported revenue of $23,769,000,000 for the fiscal year ending November 28, 2025, according to its most recent 10-K filing. The harvested content focuses on Adobe Express, which the company describes as a free, all-in-one design, photo, and video tool intended to make content creation easy, covering social content, videos, and logos.

Adobe's tracked AI products span several categories. Adobe Express AI is a lightweight design tool integrated with Adobe Firefly, Adobe's image generation model, which the company claims is trained on commercially safe data. Premiere Pro AI extends those capabilities into professional video editing, offering features such as generative extend and color match, also under a commercial-safe training claim. Adobe Podcast AI focuses on audio enhancement, including speech enhancement and microphone check functionality. The company describes an AI Assistant 2 within Adobe Express that allows users to prompt, create, and edit content while preserving chosen elements across layers.

The site's held facts record 161 legal matters with California exposure, though no individual case details are present in the data. Adobe holds a CIK of 0000796343 with the SEC, confirming its status as a reporting public company.
